evidence.observation: The baseline uses a fixed phi=66 degrees, theta=-58 degrees, and focal_distance=22, with no explicit zoom or frame center.
The habitat floor is a 7 by 5 field of 35 tiles spanning x=-6..6 and z=-4..4, so it can dominate the projected frame around the smaller central subject.
Agent nodes are placed on radii 2.1, 2.48, or 2.86 and their labels are later made fixed-in-frame; the scene therefore has a compact subject plus labels that can overlap in screen space.
The task-orbit radii extend to 4.8 and the task caption is fixed to the right edge, creating a wide late-stage framing constraint.

The available render is 854x480, 15 fps, 172 frames, and 11.466 seconds. Visual checks at approximately 4s, 7s, and 10-11s show the floor filling the viewport, the worker cluster remaining central and compact, and agent labels overlapping in the label beat.
The source-bound snapshot is 13 working agents, 2 idle agents, and 60 tasks, with the film claim that workers leave bounded traces; no additional data is needed for this framing candidate.
